# Submission Pack Structure — 8/2/RNM0614 (Mgodlwa Bridge)

Assembly order follows the tender document's own T2.1 returnables schedule
("The tenderer must complete and return documents A1 to A21; B1 to B2; C1.1
and C3 as listed below as part of his/her tender submission"), keeping the
issued document's flow intact (guide "Overberg Rule": do not dismember the
bid document; insert supporting annexures directly behind the form they
support; initial every page).

## Envelope and logistics

- **One sealed envelope** containing the **ORIGINAL bid document plus ONE
  extra (01) copy** — "failure to submit one extra copy will result in
  disqualification". Mark both ORIGINAL and COPY on their covers.
- Endorse the envelope: tender number **8/2/RNM0614**, tender title, closing
  date 2026-09-08 12:00, bidder name and address.
- Deliver to the **bid box, foyer, Municipal Offices, 10 Connor Street,
  Port Shepstone** before 12:00. Courier must place it IN the box.
- All forms completed in **BLACK INK**; no Tipp-Ex; initial corrections.

## File order (single bound original; copy identical)

**Part T2 – Schedule A (incorporated documents, completed and signed):**

1. A1 Authority To Sign Documents — board resolution attached behind it
2. A2 Letter Of Good Standing, Workmen's Compensation Commissioner (COIDA)
3. A3 Certificate Of Authority for Joint Ventures — marked N/A (no JV)
4. A4 Schedule Of Work Carried Out by The Tenderer
5. A5 Current And Recent Projects for RNM (RNM/MBD5.2) — marked "None"
6. A6 Schedule Of Construction Plant
7. A7 Schedule Of Estimated Monthly Expenditure
8. A8 Monthly Expenditure – Past Experience (RNM/MBD5.1)
9. A9 Details Of Key Personnel — CVs of company owner + site agent behind
   it, with SAQA certification for any foreign qualification and
   certified qualification copies (functionality evidence: criteria 1–2)
10. A10 Pricing Schedule – Firm Prices (RNM/MBD3.1)
11. A11 Schedule Of Daywork Rates — every line priced (no blanks/dashes)
12. A12 Record Of Addenda — every addendum listed and signed
13. A13 Company Registration Documents (CIPC certified set)
14. A14 Certified ID copies — all directors
15. A15 Joint Venture Disclosure Form — N/A
16. A16 Declaration Of Interest (RNM/MBD 4)
17. A17 Declaration For Procurement Above R10 Million (RNM/MBD 5) —
    **three years' audited AFS bound behind it**
18. A18 Declaration Of Bidder's Past SCM Practices (RNM/MBD 8)
19. A19 Certificate Of Independent Tender Determination (RNM/MBD 9)
20. A20 Form Concerning Fulfilment of the Construction Regulations —
    bid-stage H&S plan behind it
21. A21 Preference Points Claim Form PPR 2022 (RNM/MBD 6.1) — **fresh full
    CSD report behind it as locality verification** (RNM locality goal,
    10 points)

**Part T2 – Schedule B (attached by tenderer):**

22. B1 CIDB Contractor Registration Certificate — grading **6CE**, active
23. B2 Tax Pin (RNM/MBD2) — SARS TCS PIN letter

**Part C (contract documents):**

24. C1.1 Form Of Offer and Acceptance — signed, price in words AND figures,
    witnessed; total reconciled to A10 pricing schedule to the cent
25. C1.2 Contract Data (as issued)
26. C1.3 Performance Guarantee pro-forma (as issued; instrument post-award)
27. C1.4 OH&S Agreement — signed
28. C2 Pricing Data and Bill of Quantities — every item priced, arithmetic
    self-audited, carried to C1.1
29. C3 Scope of Work (as issued, initialled)

## Cross-checks before sealing

- The "Match Law": C1.1 total = A10/C2 total, in words and figures.
- Every page initialled bottom-right (including blanks); black ink.
- Both generated SDK packs (`03-bid-pack.html` MBD spread,
  `03-bid-pack-cidb-overlay.html` C1.1/T2.x/H&S) used as field-for-field
  transcription checklists against the OFFICIAL forms — never submitted in
  their place.
- Copy count: ORIGINAL + 1 COPY, both complete, both in the envelope.
